summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.90/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.90 a gallon across Wisconsin as of August 2, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 8¢ higher than a week ago, 35¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.02 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.65) and the highest in Marshfield ($4.09).
